markscheme.html:
a

A central bright maximum with alternating dark minima and secondary maxima (bright fringes) on both sides
[1 mark]

The pattern is symmetrical about the centre and the intensity of the secondary maxima decreases away from the centre (central maximum is the widest/brightest)
[1 mark]

b

The angular spread of the diffraction pattern decreases so the fringes/central maximum become narrower (minima move closer to the centre)
[1 mark]

Diffraction becomes less noticeable because the pattern is less spread out / maxima are closer together
[1 mark]

c

Most of the energy is concentrated in the central maximum
[1 mark]
